externalDeps: @elevenlabs/react-native (native; LiveKit/WebRTC transitive) - ABSENT from fork package.json
ElevenLabs cloud (live mic audio egress; per-minute billing)
whyForkRemoved: Sprint D/E systematic deletion of central-server + monetization coupling: server voice route removed (api.md:12,94; backend-architecture.md:153), client apiVoice.ts + encryption removed (encryption.md:63), storage realtimeMode debounce removed (storage.ts:219), enforced by guard test encryptionDeletion.spec.ts:62. Voice was a paid cloud feature (experimental/roadmap.md:9) and e-ink-hostile (animated VoiceBars).
verdict: Full functional restore NOT worth it on an e-ink, no-central-server, self-host fork. It re-couples to a central-server credential broker + RevenueCat gating + streams mic audio to ElevenLabs cloud (cost+privacy) + animated status bar (e-ink hostile). Bypass mode (user-owned public ElevenLabs agent, agentId only, no server) makes a minimal restore feasible if voice is wanted. Mic UI already restored inert (HA-6), so keep-removed loses nothing.
infraGaps: Server /v1/voice/conversations route removed (Sprint E) - needed for FULL mode only; bypass mode needs none
survivingDeps: happy-wire voice.ts schemas RETAINED (unused in bypass mode)
AgentInput mic props onMicPress/isMicActive RESTORED but INERT (HA-6)
operatorDecisionCalls: Want voice at all on an e-ink reading tablet?
Accept live mic audio egress to ElevenLabs cloud (privacy)?
Accept ElevenLabs per-minute cost (bypass = billed to user's own agent account)?
Accept adding @elevenlabs/* native deps to a hand-maintained no-prebuild Android build?
Bypass-only (user supplies public agent id) vs full (re-add server route + ElevenLabs API key on daemon)?
einkPlacement: Reuse upstream tablet convention: full bar suppressed on tablet, compact sidebar variant (VoiceAssistantStatusBar already has variant 'full'|'sidebar'). Replace animated VoiceBars + pulsing StatusDot with a STATIC text status row. Gate whole feature behind default-OFF enableVoiceAssistant toggle.
guardTestNote: encryptionDeletion.spec.ts:62 'has no voice or realtime production surfaces' will FAIL on any restore; must be scoped/relaxed as a first-class story.
